primary_source_audit: OpenSSL primary trigger conditions independently reviewed in the paired Agent source audit; this document measures the separate Web runtime rather than reusing its Agent reachability conclusions.

findings.basis: Only TCP80 is listening; no UDP socket, no OpenSSL QUIC-client constructor import outside the implementation, and curl lacks HTTP3. Nginx has a compiled HTTP3 module but current config does not enable it.

findings.required_trigger: OpenSSL QUIC client CRYPTO retransmission processing
findings.basis: The same current QUIC-client entry path is absent. This does not assert that OpenSSL QUIC code is absent or repaired.

findings.required_trigger: AES-GCM-SIV multi-part AAD including an empty update
findings.basis: The libraries retain AES-GCM-SIV. The configured Web path serves plain HTTP and proxies plain HTTP; no JS or other dynamic module is loaded and no application endpoint selects an arbitrary EVP cipher or supplies AAD.

findings.required_trigger: AES-GCM-SIV initialization using an IV length other than 12 bytes
findings.basis: No current Web API supplies cipher names or IVs to EVP; this is a current application-route conclusion, not a claim that the installed primitive is fixed.

findings.required_trigger: CMS encryption to a hostile EC recipient certificate
findings.basis: An ACME debug module imports CMS_encrypt and is retained in the inventory. It is not loaded by current config or master maps. There is no openssl CLI, active ACME/JS workflow or configured CMS-encryption endpoint.

reuse_conditions: Final flattened image retains these exact nonlegal native files, Nginx configuration and command/environment contract; verify its actual final identity.
Current deployment retains cleartext internal HTTP80/HTTP backend and the identified health command; new TLS/QUIC, dynamic modules, JS, ACME/CMS or custom native/CLI workflows require reassessment.
boundary: Installed OpenSSL3.5.9 is not said to contain the announced fixes. General library capabilities and arbitrary future operator-created programs/configuration are not certified. This review does not suppress or change raw scanner results.
